title: PixelPulse
tagline: An innovative social media platform where your experiences come to life through text and AI-generated images. Each post becomes an memory through NFT masterpiece shared across social media platforms!
description:
Welcome to our groundbreaking mobile app, revolutionizing social media engagement. Here, your experiences transcend mere words, as our stable diffusion model transforms them into captivating images, enriching your narrative. Every post births an exclusive NFT, immortalizing your story in the digital realm. Share these masterpieces seamlessly across platforms like Instagram, amplifying your voice and connecting with a global audience. Join us and unleash the power of your experiences!

Picture this: You share your experiences, your triumphs, your musings, in the familiar realm of text-based posts. But here’s where the magic happens. Our pioneering stable diffusion model breathes life into your words, weaving them into mesmerizing images that vividly capture the essence of your narrative. Each post becomes a canvas, a visual symphony of pixels crafted by AI, uniquely tailored to your tale.

But it doesn’t end there. We’re not just creating content; we’re minting memories. With every post, an NFT is born – a digital masterpiece that transcends the confines of traditional media, embodying the essence of your experience in a tangible, immutable form. These NFTs aren’t just tokens; they’re gateways to a world of connection and expression, shared effortlessly across social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, etc where your story can resonate with audiences far and wide.

Join us in redefining the boundaries of social interaction, where every moment, every sentiment, is elevated to the status of art. Step into a realm where technology serves as a conduit for creativity, where your voice is amplified, and your experiences are celebrated in all their glory. Welcome to the future of social media – where the power of your narrative knows no bounds
how_its_made:
PixelPulse is primarily based on a mobile app built with React Native enhanced with Expo and TypeScript, this is the primary point of interaction between users and our platform.

The app is powered by a custom backend built with Node.js, Express and TypeScript for APIs and core functionality.

The user onboarding and authentication are done through a mobile-based web3 wallet, in our case we have used Meta Mask Mobile Wallet to retrieve the web3 identity of the user and take other details manually and map these details together.

The AI-based image generation through users' posts and text content is done through OpenAI's stable diffusion model, we plan to fine-tune it based on our need to add other AI-generated content like voice, music and video content.

The web3 parts that include smart contract, data storage and core decentralised functionality of the platform are implemented through Arbitrum Stylus and Rust, which handles the most important part of our app.

All these are linked together through API calls and SDKs provided by the creators of these tools and technologies.
